Are you a curious and innovative person who is keen on solving complex problems? Then we have a great opportunity for you to boost your career! Join our international and ever-evolving team in Villach and proactively contribute to shaping the future!

In your new role you will:

 * Perform mechanical preparation of physical analysis (such as technology or product development or customer returns) as well as imaging with Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive X-Ray (EDX)

 * Determine overall analysis strategy (physical analysis steps)

 * Report and communicate your results and interface with relevant stakeholders

 * Take on analytical support and consulting for product and technology development projects

 * Establish analytical capability for new products and technologies

You are best equipped for this task if you have:

 * Have a Bachelor degree in the field of Physics, Material Sciences or similar

 * Idaeally bring know-how in the field of physical methods such as SEM and EDX.

 * Ideally have basic knowledge of semiconductor production

 * Are felxible and a have quick comprehension

 * Are interested in creative problem solving and knowledge sharing within local and global FA team

 * Are able to communicate in English and German

 * Are willing to work in a 6/3 shift model (morning, afternoon, night)

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry, at least employment group E (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/minimum-wages-blue-collar-workers-2025.pdf). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. A higher payment is negotiable depending on your expertise and skills. You are searching for a new challenge and are open for an international adventure? You like to drive innovation through your technical and personal contribution? This is your chance! Join us as AMS Verification Engineer (f/m/div) and enrich our team in Villach.

In your new role you will:

- Do analog focused Mixed-Signal Verification

- Create and maintain verification plans

- Define verification metrics and set-up verification environments, including analog testbenches

- Elaborate and execute tests on analog transistor level (schematic + layout) with digital RTL and gatelevel

- Team up and collaborate with colleagues from analog and digital design and verification, as well as concept engineering

You are best equipped for this task if you have:

- A degree in Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Telematics or comparable with focus on electronics

- 1-2 years of analog design knowhow and analog / analog mixed-signal verification know-how

- Experience using SystemVerilog / UVM in verification

- Good knowledge of object-oriented programming such as experience in C++, C#, SystemVerilog, etc.

Knowledge of script-programming such as Perl, Python, TCL

- Fluent English skills with German as a plus

We are filling this position through one of our leasing partners. A valid work permit for Austria (RWR+ Card) or EU citizenship is a prerequisite for this position. This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees of EEI with a minimum salary of € 3.665,31 (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2024.pdf). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. A higher payment is negotiable depending on your expertise and skills.

jobs.occupation: Staff Engineer Application Stress Test Methodologies (f/m/div)
jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

Wir machen das Leben einfacher, sicherer und umweltfreundlicher, mit Technik, die mehr leistet, weniger verbraucht und für alle verfügbar ist. Mikroelektronik von Infineon ist der Schlüssel für eine lebenswerte Zukunft. Wir achten auf schonenden Umgang mit natürlichen Ressourcen und lösen gesellschaftliche Herausforderungen: Effiziente Energienutzung, umweltgerechte Mobilität und Sicherheit in einer vernetzten Welt. 2 Staff Engineer Application Stress Test Methodologies (f/m/div) ID: HRC1166867

Join us at KAI and become a key player in the semiconductor industry, where every design and test brings us closer to a sustainable, electrified future! As our new Staff Engineer specializing in Application Stress Test Methodologies, you¿ll dive into the world of next-generation wide-bandgap power semiconductors, designing innovative test systems that explore performance under extreme conditions.

At KAI, we strive to create pioneering reliability test methods and systems for robust power semiconductor technologies. Your know-how in designing and developing test systems will help us push our technology to its limits while collaborating with a team of innovators.

Your new responsibilities:

Develop and design advanced power electronic circuits through simulations and concept studies

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather and manage system requirements effectively

Transform designs into hardware, overseeing the complete implementation process, and supervising the manufacturing phase

Evaluate and validate designs within an industrial laboratory setting

Lead stress testing using both established and newly developed test systems

Document designs, concepts, and results with clarity and precision

You are a hands-on innovator with a passion for high-performing power electronic systems. You thrive on bringing ideas to life, blending technical understanding with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Your toolkit for success includes:

Master's / PhD in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

Strong expertise in SPICE and system-level simulations of power electronic circuits

Proven experience in PCB design using industry-standard tools like ALTIUM Designer

Practical experience with power electronic hardware design, from concept to laboratory validation

Excellent communication skills in English and/or German

The ability to lead and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative workspace

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry, at least employment group G (https://www.feei.at/leistungen/informations-service/mindestlohne-und-gehalter). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. A higher payment is negotiable depending on your expertise and skills. Furthermore, Infineon offers additional employee benefits.

Apply to this position online by following the URL and entering the Job ID in our job search.
